title: The Green Valley
offer: You helped my valley all year. The green valley behind your farm has no owner: bring me two crates of cloth and two of honey for the gods' feast, and it is yours.

steps.say: Cloth for the hall. Now the honey.
Father says it at the Thing, in front of everybody: the green valley belongs to Ylva and Sigrid!

fact: At the Thing, the meeting of the free people, land and laws were decided.
